text:
maya (Product): Quick heads-up: we're opening a small Dedicated MI300X preview pool in ca-west-2 (Calgary) next week. Target go-live: 2026-05-02 16:00 UTC. Preview is limited to Dedicated customers and invited pilots. :maple_leaf:

dan (Eng-Platform): Details: initial capacity ~24 MI300X GPUs (6 nodes). Console label will be `dedicated.mi300x.preview.ca-west-2`. Reservations required for guaranteed capacity. We will allow short burst for on-demand, but for production reserve.

rachel (Eng-SRE): Infra checklist complete. Tags: `mi300x-caw2-preview`, `dedicated-ca-west`. No control-plane downtime expected. Deploy via infra pipeline.

billing-bot: Preview pricing applied: +12% over MI300 baseline. Billing item: `dedicated.mi300x.preview`.

dan (Eng-Platform): Reservation example (CLI):
```
redwood reserve --region=ca-west-2 --gpu-type=mi300x --count=2 --term=monthly
```
API: `{"region":"ca-west-2","gpu_type":"mi300x","count":2,"preview":true}`

maya (Product): Policy notes for preview:
- Min reservation term: 1 month
- Early cancel: 7-day notice
- Priority allocation: existing Dedicated contracts first
DM ops-kai for exceptions.

ops-kai: Routing & fallback: requests that request `gpu_type=mi300x` route to the new pool when available. If capacity exhausted, responses will queue if `allow_queue=true` else return `INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY`. Recommend clients include `fallback_gpu_types=[\"mi300\",\"a100\"]` and exponential backoff.

dan (Eng-Platform): Known preview limitations: quantization profiles experimental, max seq length default 8k, no cross-zone live migration. Monitor Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> ca-west-2 -> mi300x.

maya (Product): Action items:
1) Teams wanting preview access, submit reservation by 2026-04-30 23:59 UTC.
2) Add `gpu_type=mi300x` and fallback list in client flags.
3) Report issues to #eng-platform with `mi300x` tag.

rachel (Eng-SRE): Monitoring: we'll watch memory pressure, thermal, scheduling latency for 72h post-launch. Pager rules in place.

maya (Product): Thanks all 389 we'll share an exec note after 48h with early metrics.
